message.content:
Yes—**early Coca-Cola did contain cocaine**, because its original recipe used coca leaf extract that included the drug in the late 1800s.[1][4][7]

It was **removed in the early 1900s**; Coca-Cola now states that it does **not** contain cocaine and has never had it as an added ingredient in its current formula.[2][4][7]

A useful distinction is that the **name “Coca-Cola”** comes from **coca leaves** and **kola nuts**, but modern Coke uses a **de-cocainized coca leaf extract** for flavoring.[1][4][7]
